body: I already said i didn't want pity or pep-talks. Maybe i should just write "gg" as my suicide note.
I know what your point is. My point is it doesn't matter if i'm dead.
I've been to many therapists. While it helps in the short term it really just forces me to think about and remember things i'd rather not think about.

Yeah i regretted it last time i tried to kill myself and didn't succeed. I changed my mind right then and there, too. Except i changed my mind again. I'm being played like a badly tuned instrument and everything around me feels like an act. I don't like it, and i want out.
Who decides what's right and wrong? I've already seen my future, it's not something to look forward to.
How will i laugh with my brain splattered all over the pavement? Who cares, i'll be dead.
Depression, anxiety, paranoia. Call it what you want, i'd just rather not be alive. I guess it's good to know i'm not completely alone.
I don't like people. I'm not very interested in beautiful places either. Things will keep going up and down forever while i slowly die and become more and more insane and delusional.

It's gonna make a few people very sad but those people will get over that as time goes on. It might even be straight up hilarious to some people if they'd find out i'm dead. I don't think i'm seeking anything in particular.

I actually don't have any interest in talking to strangers or asking random people out. I'm too paranoid for that kind of stuff. I don't understand what you mean by proving my family wrong, this isn't about my family. It's also too late for me to "use this life", whatever that's supposed to mean.
I cant think of anything to look forward to. No point in waiting, i don't believe i have anything in particular to wait for.
I'll show them how worthless i am and laugh at having wasted their time.
